component.name: COSMIC Cheatsheet
component.summary: Look up your keyboard shortcuts at a glance

description.p: COSMIC Cheatsheet shows every keyboard shortcut your desktop currently has configured, in one screen you can call up with a key combination of your choice and dismiss just as quickly.

The list is read live from the COSMIC compositor, merging the system defaults with your own custom bindings, so it always matches what your keyboard actually does. Shortcuts you changed or disabled in Settings are reflected immediately.

ul.li: A full-screen overlay grouped by category: navigation, window management, tiling, system and your own custom shortcuts
Opens on a configurable key combination, Super and Shift and slash by default, which takes effect without logging out
Search box that filters by action, category, key or command as you type
Click a system or custom shortcut to run it straight away, or press Enter to run the first match
An optional panel applet that opens the same sheet with one click
Follows your COSMIC light or dark theme

screenshot.caption: Every configured shortcut, grouped by category
Type to filter the list; runnable actions are highlighted
Choose the key combination that opens the cheatsheet

description.p: The cheatsheet now opens as a fullscreen window when the desktop does not offer layer-shell to the application, which is the case for sandboxed builds.
